description:
ServerStatus/get, Peer/get, and GroupLog/get are restricted to operators. Non-operator access is silently rejected with a 'forbidden' JMAP error today. Add an audit event so privilege escalation attempts are visible.

## Current code (route_method, server.rs ~line 1373)
  "ServerStatus/get" => {
      if !is_operator {
          return serde_json::to_value(MethodError::forbidden()).unwrap_or(json!({}));
      }
      ...
  }
  (Same pattern for Peer/get and GroupLog/get)

## Audit events to add

  On operator-gate rejection:
    tracing::warn!(
        audit         = true,
        event.type    = "authz.forbidden",
        method        = %method,       // "ServerStatus/get" etc.
        username      = %username,
        source_ip     = %source_ip,    // forwarded from JmapCaller
        "operator gate: access denied",
    );

  On operator-gate success (admin method actually called):
    tracing::info!(
        audit         = true,
        event.type    = "admin.method_called",
        method        = %method,
        username      = %username,
        "operator method invoked",
    );

## JmapCaller changes needed
  source_ip must be added to JmapCaller (String) so it is available inside
  route_method. Currently JmapCaller has username but not source_ip.
  Populate it from the request extension set by B1.

## Acceptance
- Test: non-operator calling ServerStatus/get → authz.forbidden audit event emitted
- Test: operator calling ServerStatus/get → admin.method_called audit event emitted
- username and method fields are correct in both cases
title: Add audit events at JMAP operator-gate rejections
